article.title: Data Leakage: When a Model Learns from the Future

paragraphs.en: Data leakage happens when information that would not be available at the real prediction time enters model training. Leakage can make validation performance look excellent while producing a model that fails in production. A simple example is using a cancellation code to predict whether a customer will cancel when that code is recorded only after the cancellation process begins. Another form is temporal leakage: calculating a feature with transactions that occur after the scoring date. Leakage can also enter through preprocessing. If statistics used to transform data are calculated from the full dataset before the train-test split, information from the test period can influence training. Target encoding and feature selection require particular care. The solution begins with a clear decision timestamp. For every feature, analysts should ask whether the value existed and was accessible at that exact moment. Time-based validation is often more realistic than a random split when the model will predict future outcomes. Pipelines should reproduce the same feature logic in training and serving. Documentation should include source tables, event timestamps, aggregation windows, refresh timing, and known delays. A suspiciously large performance jump after adding a feature deserves investigation rather than celebration. Leakage is dangerous because it can survive ordinary metric checks: the model genuinely predicts the label in the historical dataset, but it does so using information the future system cannot possess. Production-ready modeling therefore requires not only predictive skill but also strict control of time and information availability. Analysts should define the population, timing, comparison, and uncertainty before turning an observed pattern into a business conclusion. paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳・解説：sample、selection、segment、情報の時点、decision valueの観点から、表面的なmetricだけでは分析できない理由を説明する。data generating process、対象population、情報取得時点、観察関係がbusiness conclusionを支持する範囲を確認することが重要である。
